title: Maximum velocity expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for v_m must be correctly expressed as mg(R+r)sinθ/(B²L²).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law at equilibrium, equating the gravitational force component to the magnetic damping force.

title: Induced EMF and current
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply Faraday's law to find the induced EMF (BLv) and Ohm's law for the total circuit resistance (R+r).

title: Total Joule heat expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for Q must be derived from energy conservation: mgx sinθ minus the final kinetic energy, or an equivalent correct form.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must state that the loss in gravitational potential energy equals the gain in kinetic energy plus the total Joule heat.

title: Time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for t must be correctly expressed as m(R+r)/(B²L²) + (B²L²x)/(mg(R+r)sinθ).

title: Differential equation solution
description: Important Criteria: The solution for time must involve setting up and solving the equation of motion (F_net = m dv/dt) or using an integrated form.

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the magnetic force (BIL) is given the same direction as the gravitational component, accelerating the rod.

title: Incorrect circuit resistance
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the total resistance in Ohm's law is taken as only R or only r, instead of the series sum (R+r).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may demonstrate that the final expressions for v_m, Q, and t have correct physical dimensions.
